source.author: verg
source.text: In te ora Latini, in te oculos referunt; mussat rex ipse Latinus, quos generos vocet aut quae sese ad foedera flectat.
source.text_original: In te ora Latini, / in te oculos referunt; mussat rex ipse Latinus, / quos generos vocet aut quae sese ad foedera flectat.
source.text_english: To you the faces of the Latins are turned, to you their eyes; King Latinus himself murmurs, whom to call sons-in-law, or to what alliance he should incline himself.
